    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        d = (i - 1) * (i - 2) // 2
        lo = m - d
        hi = m + d

        for y in range(width):
            total = 0

                x = y - t

                    total += (i - abs(t)) * dp[i - 1][x]
            dp[i][y] = total % mod

                x = y + gap
